title: TG Gene Mutations and Congenital Hypothyroidism
brief_summary: The aim of this study was to identify mutations in the thyroglobulin gene that might be present in patients with fetal goiter and congenital goiter hypothyroidism.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with congenital hypothyroidism due to thyroglobulin defective synthesis.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with another disease.
